```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
# Load packages
library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

# Load the billboard dataset
data("billboard", package = "tidyr")

# Transform the data: convert wide to long format
billboard_long <- billboard %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("wk"),
    names_to = "week",
    values_to = "rank",
    values_drop_na = TRUE
  ) %>%
  mutate(week = as.integer(sub("wk", "", week)))

# Plot: duration on chart vs. artist
billboard_long %>%
  group_by(artist, track) %>%
  summarise(weeks_on_chart = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(weeks_on_chart)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 20) %>%  # top 20 longest-lasting songs
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(track, weeks_on_chart), y = weeks_on_chart, fill = artist)) +
  geom_col(show.legend = FALSE) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Top 20 Songs with Longest Billboard Chart Duration",
    x = "Track",
    y = "Weeks on Chart"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10)
  )

```
